title: Everywhere-defined left derived functors are exact
statement: Let $D$ and $D'$ be triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category], let $F:D\to D'$ be an exact functor, and let $S$ be a saturated multiplicative system in $D$ compatible with the triangulated structure. Let $Q:D\to S^{-1}D$ be the localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If the left derived functor $LF:S^{-1}D\to D'$ is defined at every object of $D$ in the sense of Definition Tag 05S9, then the functor $LF$ characterized by the universal property (equation derived-equation-everywhere) is exact as a functor of triangulated categories.
